name: MSA
description: Master Services Agreement. Umbrella contract setting general legal terms between a client and service provider for all future engagements: agreement term and renewal, termination for breach, invoicing and payment terms, confidentiality, intellectual property ownership, warranties, indemnification, limitation of liability, data protection, governing law and arbitration.

name: SOW
description: Statement of Work. Project-specific document issued under a parent MSA (it refers to the MSA by date). Contains project name and overview, in-scope and out-of-scope items, deliverables and milestones with due dates, team composition with roles and FTE counts, total SOW value or fixed price, milestone-based payment schedule, assumptions, acceptance criteria and change request process.

name: MoM
description: Minutes of Meeting. Record of a single meeting: meeting title, date, time, venue or video-call link, chairperson, attendees and absentees, agenda, discussion points per agenda item, decisions taken, and an action-item table with owners and due dates, often ending with the next meeting date.

name: AoA
description: Articles of Association of a company under the Companies Act, 2013. Internal rulebook of the company: interpretation, private company restrictions, share capital, lien, calls on shares, transfer and transmission of shares, alteration of capital, general meetings and quorum, voting rights, board of directors and board proceedings, dividends, accounts, winding up, indemnity. Often references Table F of Schedule I.

name: MoA
description: Memorandum of Association of a company under the Companies Act, 2013. Short charter document organised as numbered clauses: Name clause, Registered Office clause (state), Objects clause (III-A main objects, III-B matters in furtherance), Liability clause, Capital clause (authorised share capital divided into equity shares of Rs 10 each), and Subscription clause with subscribers' names and number of shares taken.

name: BS
description: Balance Sheet. Financial statement of a company as at a date (usually 31st March), mostly a table with current-year and previous-year columns: Equity and Liabilities (share capital, reserves and surplus, borrowings, trade payables, provisions) and Assets (property plant and equipment, investments, inventories, trade receivables, cash and cash equivalents), with matching totals, note numbers, accounting policies and an auditor (Chartered Accountants, FRN) signature.

name: EC
description: Employment Contract (employment agreement or appointment terms) between a company and one individual employee: job title and reporting line, date of joining, probation, salary or CTC breakup (basic, HRA, PF, allowances), working hours, leave entitlement, duties, confidentiality and IP assignment by the employee, non-solicitation, notice period and termination.

name: NDA
description: Non-Disclosure Agreement. Standalone confidentiality agreement to evaluate a potential business relationship: purpose of disclosure, definition of confidential information, obligations of the receiving party, exclusions, term of confidentiality, return or destruction of materials, injunctive relief.
